description:
A star rating from 1 to 5.

Examples:
    >>> Rating(score=5).score
    5
    >>> try:
    ...     Rating(score=0)
    ... except ValidationError:
    ...     print("below range rejected")
    below range rejected
    >>> try:
    ...     Rating(score=6)
    ... except ValidationError:
    ...     print("above range rejected")
    above range rejected
title: Rating
